Definition: Hor, the name of a peak in Idumaea and of one in Syria
BiblicalUsage: Hor is a mountain in Edom, named 12 times in Scripture, in Numbers and Deuteronomy. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God met His people at Hor, a real place in His story, and that is why I take its name seriously. I hold that even a place the Bible names only briefly is worth knowing.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
